chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no problem with encircling the sword with the gold and the silver.
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for men to have swords decorated with gold and silver?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that adorning swords with gold and silver is permissible, resolving the juristic debate on whether such embellishment constitutes prohibited luxury (takhalluq) for men. It highlights the Shia scholarly view that functional items like weapons are exempt from the general restrictions on gold usage, emphasizing practicality over strict asceticism in this specific context.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, form Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is no problem with encircling the sword with the gold and the silver’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘ Umayr from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
It is not unlawful to decorate the sword with gold and silver.’”
